placements.title: Day-old bread is marked down while buyers are still in the shop
placements.frame: What does this say about when a day-old markdown has to land to reach buyers, and what else on the shop floor has to move with it?
placements.why: No existing leaf touches bakery pricing; the branch-hours and greenhouse-sensor leaves are unrelated. DayOldMarkdownTiming carries the theme: the markdown moves from close to two in the afternoon because nobody is left to buy at close, and the shelf card changes at the same hour so the price holds no surprise at the till. Future pricing and signage calls can keep feeding this theme.
